variables: D_l[d_out_l,actual_B], nominal local-target residuals; optimize v_lr=D_lr/entry_anchor_norm_lr
realized_local_action: D_l @ P_l.T @ current_key_lrc(D_lower); NOT necessarily D_lr

writer.context_weights: native writer alpha, sum one per request
writer.commit: copy identical final accepted W_eff tensors
writer.weight_gradient: direct D gradient; qualified against dense reference; full input VJP required

objective.reference_K: mean sampled past fact, native KL weights, full vocabulary KL(current||immutable admission-entry teacher)
objective.reference_E: mean sampled past fact and native rewrite contexts: 0.5*positive_part(target_token_mean_NLL-current_latest_commit_context_NLL)^2

memory.content: observed native token IDs, native target identities, fact/version metadata, FP32 full-vocab native KL log-probabilities, per-context committed target NLL scalars
memory.policy: Algorithm R over first-observed unique fact IDs; seen out-of-bank repeats not readmitted; in-bank repeats replace rewrite target/anchor but retain KL teacher
memory.sample: once per batch, deterministic uniform without replacement from bank excluding current fact IDs; all native contexts/target positions
memory.KL_identity: tokens+mask+positions+readout; share earliest resident teacher, reset only if identity evicted then legitimately readmitted by a new fact
memory.rewrite_version: latest stream occurrence; current batch conflicts retained in current task; resident KL input tuple and teacher frozen together
memory.shared_teacher_ownership: refcount by owner fact; apply pending events in stream order after commit; drop at last-owner eviction, new later admission may create a new teacher
memory.metadata_bound: payload at most M facts; seen_fact_ids metadata grows with unique fact count
memory.current_exclusion_scope: fact IDs, not every shared KL input identity
memory.weak_commit: store finite committed state; not a guarantee of successful edit
memory.storage: RAM only, included in atomic rollback

history.append_count: once per actual occurrence per committed batch
history.known_limit: older upper-layer keys can remain stale; functional replay covers sampled native inputs only

solver.name: global_scalar_proximal_gradient
solver.first_step: nu/max_group_grad_norm, nu=c/4; zero gradient at v=0 returns zero
solver.next_trial_step: min(last_accepted_tau,nu/max_group_grad_norm); if zero gradient reuse prior tau
solver.backtracking: halve active trial tau on smooth-majorization failure, retain accepted v/f/g; do not reinitialize tau until acceptance; all trials count
solver.return: last accepted physical candidate, including zero if none
solver.initial_accepted_state: zero candidate; first active tau initialized from its gradient
solver.early_exit: zero proximal mapping or identical v; NOT merely identical FP32 materialized weight; record actual calls

runtime.cache_boundary: before earliest edited linear operation, all relevant positions; NO upper subject-prefix KV replay
runtime.microbatch: stream complete physical loss gradients then one global joint update
runtime.entry_pass: separate no-grad native key/anchor/teacher collection before zero-candidate backward
runtime.selected_head: all vocabulary at required positions only
